text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident triggered: `queue.backlog.high` on service=redwood-inference-runtime region=us-west-2 severity=high :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Triggered alert: PD-19283 — Queue backlog > 75% for 10m; assigned to `oncall/eng-runtime`
alex: acked via PD, I'm on it. looking at autoscaler metrics now
maria: seeing sustained increase in request concurrency across gpu-pool-3, autoscaler target not growing, queue depth climbing in prometheus: `queue_length{pool=\"gpu-pool-3\"}` ~ 860 -> 1200 in last 6m
chen: confirmed, autoscaler logs show repeated scale loop failures: `failed to provision node: quotaExceeded` - provider returned 403.
sam_oncall: got the 403s earlier today during a partial AZ outage? provider support ticket still open. any chance of manual workarounds?
alex: if quota is the blocker we can: 1) switch some workload to gpu-pool-2 (less busy) 2) enable temporary burst capacity (if provider allows) 3) start manual vertical splits (reduce batch size)
maria: traffic is mixed; high-latency tail for hosted API endpoints hitting the runtime. customers on Dedicated might see increased latencies too. need triage on user impact
ingrid: putting customer impact note: "Some API requests returning 503 or >2s latency for a subset of traffic; bulk embeddings jobs are delayed."
chen: here's the autoscaler controller snippet from logs:```
E 2026-03-14T15:02:04Z autoscaler.go:243 scaleUpAttempt failed: CreateInstances call failed: quotaExceeded: request=4, available=0 region=us-west-2.az1
stack: runtime/autoscaler -> cloud/provisioner -> provider/api
```
alex: starting migration: routing policy change to prefer gpu-pool-2 for new requests to reduce pressure on gpu-pool-3. applying route tweak now.
sam_oncall: can you post the command? I'll verify after you run it
alex: `kubectl patch svc inference-router -n prod -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity": "None"}}'` (we're adjusting weights through feature flags instead, pushing a quick toggle)
maria: I flipped traffic flag to divert ~30% to gpu-pool-2 (ff:route.pool_preference=pool2). monitoring queue depth.
incident-bot: reroute: flag change detected by deploy-bot at 15:06 UTC.
chen: queue_length gpu-pool-3 dropping from 1200 -> 760 in 3m. good sign. latency 95p still elevated though (1.6s -> 1.2s).
ingrid: opened a brief customer comms draft in #support: "We're seeing increased processing times for some requests in us-west-2; teams are mitigating and we expect improvement within 30 minutes." please review
sam_oncall: PD escalations: if autoscaler can't scale because of provider quota, we should escalate to infra on-call and also consider temporary rate limiting. pinging @kevin-infra
alex: hitting provider API limits also, so manual scale is blocked. starting temporary rate-limit rule on ingress to shed low-priority traffic: `rlimit set --service inference --policy shed-low --rate 100rps`
maria: applying rate-limit. starting to see reduction in queue growth. backlog now ~450 across pools.
pagerduty: PD note: acknowleged by alex (oncall/eng-runtime). Two escalations remaining in 20m if unresolved.
chen: adding a short-term kvcache eviction to reduce memory churn; command: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api/cache/evict?pool=gpu-pool-3 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```
alex: eviction ran, cache miss spikes but reduces memory footprint. workers start accepting more inflight.
ingrid: updating support message: "Improvement observed after routing and rate-limiting changes; we're monitoring and will follow up."
sam_oncall: opening infra PD: PD-19284 created for provider quota limit blocking autoscaler. pinged kevin-infra and escalated.
kevin-infra: (joined) saw the provider quota alert; requesting immediate uplift is in progress, but ETA from provider is ~25-40m. Meanwhile, we can provision from another region or use reserved capacity if enabled
maria: can we burst to reserved capacity? I think we have a small reserved pool in us-west-1. cross-region adds latency but avoids queue saturation
alex: plan: 1) continue traffic diversion to pool-2 2) enable reserved pool in us-west-1 for async jobs (bulk embeddings) 3) keep rate-limit for low-priority requests 4) monitor and update PD threads.
chen: pushing a canary move of async job queue to us-west-1 now.```kubectl set env deployment/async-worker ASYNC_REGION=us-west-1 -n prod```
maria: async queue drained by ~60% after move, overall queue across all pools down to ~180.
incident-bot: PD Update: alert severity downgraded to medium; auto-escalation window paused by alex (ack).
sam_oncall: handoff note for next oncall in 30m: current status — backlog decreasing, autoscaler still blocked by provider quota, provider ETA ~30m, mitigation in place: routing + rate-limits + async offload. please continue watch and coordinate with infra if provider ETA slips.
ingrid: posted incident note in #incidents-digest for internal tracking.
alex: I'll remain reachable for another 25m, then hand off. thanks all for quick moves. :heart:
chen: leaving a link to graphs: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/runtimes/queue-backlog?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now
pagerduty: PD: incident resolved signal still pending.
sam_oncall: last check: 95p latency ~0.9s, error rate back to baseline. closing PD if no regressions in 15m.
ingrid: final customer note queued for release when PD closed.
alex: handoff complete — tagging @oncall/next.
pagerduty: PD: incident acknowledged cleared by alex at 15:47 UTC; closing window timer started.
incident-bot: Incident closed by automation after 20m of stable metrics.
